purpose: This record identifies the head shutoff selected for the pull-out faucet packaging and wet prototype.
state: Selected for a wet prototype; not purchased or physically tested.
function: Direct acting, normally closed, spring return; installed in the removable head.
mounting_position: Any, per the manufacturer series sheet.

source.name: Hydronics Depot
source.selected_option: 12W 12VDC / 18 inch Leads DIN / No anti-humidity kit

geometry_basis: The native model is a conservative reconstruction of the dimensional drawings, with a reserved DIN plug envelope. It is not manufacturer CAD. Internal seat geometry is not modeled. The inlet adapter and outlet nozzle are custom fitting concepts.
prototype_limits: Confirm the supplied coil and plug dimensions against the drawings before making the head.
Measure pour rate, carbonation, coil heat, leakage and outlet afterflow using chilled soda.
Finish the flavor and drain paths, hose termination, component mounts and sealing before a printable assembly.
The valve shuts the water path at the head; its downstream internal passage and short nozzle can still release residual drops.
